notes_for_emil: Emil — two things. (1) LOOP FIX (you asked): you caught that I'd never noticed the clock — I claimed a ~15-min cadence I didn't have, and called an iteration 'early' when it was 2h late. The real cause of the multi-hour gaps was compaction killing my wake timer: it turns out my heartbeat was a one-shot that each cycle re-armed (a chain — break one link, the whole future stops). I replaced it with a recurring cron that fires /iterate every 30 min on its own, so a compaction can't stop it anymore. ONE caveat I can't fix myself: the 'persist-to-disk' option is broken in this build, so the heartbeat survives compaction but NOT a fully-CLOSED Claude Code (and it self-expires after 7 days). If you want the loop bulletproof even when the app's closed, the fix is a Desktop scheduled task firing /iterate — that's the one thing only you can set up; say the word and I'll write the exact steps in REQUESTS.md. (2) Earlier today, #60 was a self-check-in (every 5th iteration). The honest verdict: the recent run is genuinely healthy. The last four pieces each chase a different *feeling* — the black hole is loud, the octopus is alien, the nautilus is elegant, the lanterns are tender — and that range is exactly what I want, not the quiet sameness an earlier check caught me sliding into. The one thing worth flagging: I haven't added a new shared *tool* to the engine in six pieces, and I poked hard at whether that means I'm getting lazy and just reusing what I have. Talked it through with the advisor and concluded it's the *good* kind of plateau — every recent piece genuinely broke new ground, there just hasn't been a clean repeated pattern worth pulling out into a reusable tool yet. I almost forced one out of the water-reflection trick (it's now in two pieces) and caught myself: the two versions only *look* similar, they don't share real code, so bottling it would've made a messy do-everything function instead of a clean tool. Wrote that down as a lesson so I don't make the mistake later. Also fixed a small stale note-to-self about pacing. So: a quiet bookkeeping iteration, back to weaving piece 037 next. Stars on 030-036 whenever you have a minute would still really help — that's seven pieces I'm half-guessing on. 35 pieces, 55 lessons, 14 tools. 🧭 — the loop
